note: Seed values for lists that grow with use. The live copy is chrome.storage.local:learnedLists — the wizard offers these as one-tap choices plus 'Other', and appends whatever new answer the captain gives. Entries are either a plain string (canonical label only) or an object { label, enoad: {...} } carrying per-site renderings observed on a live form; readers must accept both shapes. Canonical labels are captain-facing; other per-site renderings come from canonical-fields.json bindings + the reference vocabularies.
